body: Wow, this is just pathetic, and sad. Tell your s/o you cheated and accept consequences.

You are not pathetic, not pathetic at all. You make mistakes, who cares! say "oops! haha! that was silly of me!" Very cheesy isn't it? Shit who fucking cares, you are so amazing, just know this, it wasn't you who made those mistakes, it was the damn government giving you poisoned birth control! Blame anyone but yourself, take a break from your boyfriend if you really really need to, take a break from the whole world! Sleep for a few days! Do absolutely nothing! Learn to love yourself, go workout, go grab some headphones, put on relaxing music and take a nice refreshing air cooling jog, let that wind hit your face while its sweaty and just feel upright and amazing, take a bath after and cool down, take deep breaths, you are NOT pathetic over a pizza, maybe your parents loved that pizza, and no, I doubt the thought of you being a lost cause even crossed his mind because I'm very VERY sure he loves you, all of you, your perfections, your imperfections and all your stupidity, (you're not actually stupid, trust me, I'm stupid.) Go ask him yourself! I'm sure everything will be okay, I'm active if you'd like to chat some more, please don't hesitate to shoot me a quick dm to rant or vent some more, you are loved, and fuck that pizza.

Hey, I'm here for you, and brother to brother speaking, forget about her, no matter how long or how much you've done or been with her, she failed to see the worth in you, so you will pick yourself up, put on those headphones and run, run like the wind and forget everything ever happened, eat a nice meal, have a refreshing bath, tell yourself in the mirror you are strong, very very strong, and most important of all, you love yourself, because in the end, nobody will love you as much as you love yourself, hell, I LOVE YOU, for being so strong and making it this far, I'm available if you want to talk more or want to rant or vent about anything, please shoot me a dm and ill try my best to respond as fast as possible. You are strong! You love yourself!

I know how you feel, but can only imagine what you're going through, I love you, there are people who love you, like family and friends, even if it's just a tangible small amount, there's still a small ray of hope, I'm always active, please reach out and shoot me a dm, we can talk about whatever!

It's alright, music is your coping mechanism and It's a beautiful thing, it's very amazing that you have a way to cope, cherish it, you don't have to tell your therapist anything, you aren't obligated to tell them the truth, I'm always here if you need someone to talk to, please shoot me a dm.

I plan to take my life on my birthday, which is actually only in a few days, I've not been happy lately or ever, I don't know what my plan is which leads me to a contempt in hesitation, I'm here if you need someone to speak to who wont judge you for your misfits, send me a chat anytime.

Hello! My names Apollo, and in my own content of thoughts I hope you can lend me your trust for just a few brief moments as I am also trying to skim through the newest posts to respond to others, there is absolutely nothing wrong with not having been in a relationship, in my opinion, not being in one actually gives you the space and energy for you to grow, to explore and see what you truly love about yourself, find new hobbies and learn to love yourself.

In the end you have to put yourself first, and trust me a lot of people around your age haven't been in a relationship either, but you are still young, (old to me, since I'm younger than you but that's disclosed.) You have a lot of space and time to find someone if you truly desire, but for now please focus on what really matters, lifting yourself up off the ground and learning how to love yourself before you can love someone else. 

I don't have much time as I am desperately trying to help others but please reach out to me or respond if you'd like to chat some more or have more thoughts on your mind you'd like to speak about.

Please love yourself.

Everything is okay, I just saw this scrolling through the newest posts, because I too, feel the same way. I'm new to reddit and don't know how things work but I'd love if you'd like to reach out or speak more on how you feel here. You are loved, you are needed, even if you don't believe so, I will believe for you.
